fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Systemic Absorption : Same adverse reactions found with systemic administration of beta-adrenergic receptor inhibitors may occur with topical ophthalmic administration. ( 5.1 ) Cardiac Failure : Discontinue treatment at the first signs of cardiac failure. ( 5.2 ) Diabetes Mellitus :…

summary: Official warnings note that Betaxolol treatment should be stopped at the first signs of cardiac failure, which is when the heart cannot pump blood properly, and the drug also carries warnings related to diabetes mellitus [6]. Similar drugs, including Metoprolol, Atenolol, and Propranolol, have boxed warnings in the United States for heart harm [3][4][5]. Additionally, risk ratings from a small computer model, rather than tests on people, placed the drug at a low band with a score of 9 for liver risk and a medium band with a score of 58 for heart risk [M].
